issue.title: Unblock E2 again: a green macOS core, core cuts the steward really dispatches, and a cutover wait that tracks master
issue.description: sase-core master CI is green on macOS again, so the daily cut can merge and publish a core. The release steward counts only merge-capable release-plz runs as core cuts, so its CORE_LAG action proposes a real cut and a heal run never hides a failed cut. sase-1oe.4 waits on the core pin that origin/master names now, not on a frozen workspace pin, so it can rehearse and raise the E2 handover gate.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/unblock_e2_core_release_flow.md requests this work

issue.title: sase-core master CI passes on macOS, and a core containing the fix publishes
issue.description: macos-core: find why wal_mode_probe_consumes_conversion_budget spends 750 ms to 1.2 s of a 250 ms budget on macos-latest. Fix the product if it overshoots its wall-clock budget, or fix the oracle if the overshoot is outside the budget's control, without loosening the bound. Prove that master CI is green on both OSes and that a merge-capable cut publishes a complete core after the fix.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/unblock_e2_core_release_flow.md defines phase macos-core as one work unit

issue.title: Only merge-capable release-plz runs count as core cuts for the steward
issue.description: real-cuts: the steward's cut facts drop push and six-hourly heal runs, which never merge the release PR. CORE_LAG then proposes a real cut, and a non-merging success no longer supersedes a failed cut. The cut_budget decision bounds how often the steward dispatches. Prove it with a live read-only --once.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/unblock_e2_core_release_flow.md defines phase real-cuts as one work unit

issue.title: The cutover wait follows origin/master's current pin
issue.description: master-wait: give tools/ratchet_core_pin a read-only --ref mode that checks the pins a git ref names. Write a corrected wait procedure on sase-1oe.4. If its running monitor polls a frozen workspace pin and can be resumed safely, restart it so its continuation starts now.
